GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (24 Jan 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1486)
APO 500
24 January 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Temporary Release of Detained Suspected War Criminal.
1.The following named Japanese, presently interned in Sugamo Prison as a Suspected War Criminal, will be escorted by an authorized member of the Japanese Police from Sugamo Prison to his home in Kagawa-ken, for the purpose of visiting his father who is seriously ill.
NAME RANK DATE OF INTERNMENT
TAKUMA, Shetaro (Masataro) Sgt. 17 May 46
2. TAKUMA will be adequately guarded during his absence from Sugamo Prison and will be returned to Sugamo Prison for reincarceration within seven days from the date of his release.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
